t: The LAP USB-A to Lightning charging cable delivers reliable everyday charging for iPhone, iPad, and iPod devices. Provides 12W power with a built-in smart safety chip to prevent overheating and short circuits. The braided jacket and aluminium shell plug ensure long-lasting durability, while the 1-metre length offers flexibility for use in workshops, offices, or vehicles. Supporting standard charging speeds and optimised iOS device charging, this cable combines safety, performance, and toughness in a single, dependable solution for professional environments and daily use.
